description: The foundational fungal network underlying all Feywood soils. Rootlace handles nutrient distribution between canopy trees and understory plants, carries decomposition-chain continuity, and serves as the biological substrate through which the Heartwood's root-memory network extends beyond its physical roots. Druids read Rootlace disturbance patterns to monitor Feywood-wide stress from localized observation.

ecology.cultural_role: substrate through which the Heartwood's root-memory operates
ecology.ecological_role: foundational fungal network; nutrient exchange; root-memory substrate

name: Rootlace Mycelium
